channel.title: Car and Driver - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Car and Driver (caranddriver.com)

item.title: View Interior Photos of the 2026 Aston Martin Vantage S
item.description: See the interior of the 2026 Aston Martin Vantage S from every angle.

item.title: 2026 Aston Martin Vantage S Is Refined but Still Rowdy
item.description: Upgrades to the chassis and a little bit more power from the 4.0-liter V-8 enhance the Vantage's rip-snorting, engaging personality.

item.title: Confirmed: Toyota's Mysterious New Vehicle Is a Three-Row SUV
item.description: After a teaser that showed a chunky exterior design, Toyota has now unveiled the new model's interior, showing a three-row layout and a modern dashboard.

item.title: View Photos of the 2027 Ferrari 849 Testarossa
item.description: See the interior and exterior of the 2027 Ferrari 849 Testarossa from every angle.

item.title: 2027 Ferrari 849 Testarossa Drive: Bullet with Butterfly Wings
item.description: Essentially a rebodied SF90, the reinvented Testarossa punches up the exterior design of Ferrari's plug-in hybrid supercar.

item.title: Report: Ford Holds Talks with Chinese Automaker Xiaomi
item.description: A deal between the companies could produce a joint venture, laying the groundwork for Xiaomi to manufacture vehicles in the United States.

item.title: VW Is Recalling Nearly 44K ID.4s Due to Batteries That May Catch Fire
item.description: The recall involves 2023 to 2025 models with defective battery modules, which can be fixed with a software update.

item.title: Best New-Car Lease Deals for February 2026
item.description: As a new-car buyer, you'll enjoy more low-cost leases this month on cars you'll actually want.

item.title: Hidden Car Door Handles Are Officially Being Banned in China
item.description: Automakers have increasingly implemented door handles that retract into the bodywork for aerodynamic reasons, but they are now off limits in China.

item.title: Porsche Might Axe the New Boxster and Cayman EVs Before They Arrive
item.description: Porsche reportedly might shelve the upcoming electric 718 models to help balance its ballooning budget.
